practices.practice: Keep a person in the loop for anything that touches money, customers or compliance
practices.why_it_matters: A common pattern is for the agent to draft or classify and for a person to approve, then to loosen the review only after the error rate has been measured.

practices.practice: Check data readiness before choosing a use case
practices.why_it_matters: An agent can only work with information that is accessible and reasonably clean. If the needed data lives in paper files or in one person's head, the first project is organizing the data.
